name: Arcane Stasis (2/Day)
description: When a creature the creature can see within 60 feet of it casts a spell, the creature can magically lock the casting in the moment before completion. The spellcaster must succeed on a DC 15 saving throw using the spell’s spellcasting ability, or the spell fails and is wasted.
